channel.title: Wire — Releases
channel.description: Releases from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Amazon ECS now supports GPU sharing with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS)
item.description: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now supports GPU sharing with NVIDIA Multi-Process Service (MPS), enabling you to run multiple Amazon ECS tasks concurrently on a single NVIDIA GPU. (1 source: aws)

item.title: SageMaker MLflow Apps now support MLflow 3.16
item.description: Amazon SageMaker AI MLflow Apps now support MLflow 3.16, bringing a redesigned tracing experience and faster experiment tracking to your generative AI and machine learning workflows. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Aurora serverless now supports up to 384 ACUs
item.description: Amazon Aurora serverless now supports database capacity of up to 384 Aurora Capacity Units (ACUs) for Aurora PostgreSQL-Compatible Edition, a 50% increase from the previous maximum of 256 ACUs. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now supports changing durability on existing clusters
item.description: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now lets you enable or disable durability on your existing node-based clusters without creating a new cluster. Previously, you couldn't change the durability configuration of an existing cluster in place. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Corretto October 2026 Patch Updates
item.description: On October 26, 2026 Amazon announced a patch update for the following Amazon Corretto Long-Term Support (LTS) and Feature Release (FR) versions of OpenJDK. (1 source: aws)

item.title: Amazon Neptune now supports online index rebuild to reclaim storage
item.description: Amazon Neptune Database now supports online index rebuild, a new capability that helps database administrators and application teams defragment Neptune indexes and reclaim unused storage space without taking their database offline. (1 source: aws)
